field.label: Enable docker proxy
field.help: Write the caddy-docker-proxy connection env vars (CADDY_DOCKER_SOCKETS and friends) into the envfile. Disabling removes them; the module itself stays in the caddy binary until removed on the Modules page.

field.label: Mode
field.help: How caddy-docker-proxy discovers Docker services: Swarm services, plain containers, or both. Blank keeps the module default. Delivered as CADDY_DOCKER_PROXY_MODE.

field.label: Docker sockets
field.help: Docker daemon endpoints, comma-separated, in the CADDY_DOCKER_SOCKETS format. The default points at a remote daemon on the docker-proxy host — Docker does not run on the OPNsense box itself.

field.label: Docker certs path
field.help: Path to the TLS client certificates for the Docker daemon connection. Delivered as CADDY_DOCKER_CERTS_PATH. Leave empty to connect without client certificates.

field.label: Ingress networks
field.help: Comma-separated Docker networks the proxy is published on. Delivered as CADDY_DOCKER_INGRESS_NETWORKS.

field.label: Caddyfile path
field.help: Path of the generated Caddyfile that caddy-docker-proxy writes. Delivered as CADDY_DOCKER_CADDYFILE_PATH.

field.label: Environment file
field.help: Path of the envfile caddy-docker-proxy passes to the virtual environments it generates. Delivered as CADDY_DOCKER_ENVFILE.

field.label: Docker host
field.help: Docker daemon endpoint override passed to the Docker client. Delivered as DOCKER_HOST. Only needed when the proxy and the daemon client disagree about the socket.

field.label: Verify Docker TLS
field.help: Verify the Docker daemon TLS certificate. Delivered as DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY (1 when checked, 0 when not).
